name: ibis budget Singapore Clarke Quay
short_description: A 101-room budget hotel on Hong Kong Street beside the Singapore River, with a rooftop pool and Clarke Quay MRT steps away.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Clarke Quay sits at 20 Hong Kong Street beside the Singapore River, in one of the city's most social and well-connected districts, with Clarke Quay MRT Station and the riverside bars, restaurants, and Boat Quay all within a short walk. The 101-room economy hotel has a rooftop swimming pool, an on-site restaurant (Brekkie X Grill), free WiFi, and a car park -- unusual extras for the budget tier. Its own Accor listing shows a 4.1/5 guest rating from 245 reviews, while TripAdvisor rates it 3/5 (ranked roughly #208 of 379 Singapore hotels), with guests consistently praising the clean, well-maintained rooms and central location despite their compact size. A confirmed 2022 YouTube staycation room tour corroborates the rooftop pool and small-but-tidy Superior Room layout. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Clarke Quay part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: Does ibis budget Singapore Clarke Quay have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it has a rooftop swimming pool, an unusual amenity at this budget price point, plus an on-site restaurant, Brekkie X Grill. The hotel is a short walk from Clarke Quay MRT Station and the riverside restaurants and bars of Clarke Quay and Boat Quay.
